annotation.justification: The clause uses SHOULD, granting discretion. It does not mandate a specific PMTU discovery mechanism or packet size calculation, only that implementations *that choose to implement* PMTU discovery should maintain a per-address-pair maximum packet size. This is not ambiguous.
